title: Pin compose project name to keep fabro-storage volume identity stable
rationale: The server settings path (/storage/.home/settings.toml via FABRO_HOME) is unchanged since ecdfdd82d; the only variable across a just up refresh was the compose project name, which derives from the invocation directory and therefore mints a fresh <dir>_fabro-storage volume (empty settings -> install mode, /api/v1/* 404). Pinning name: fabro in both compose files preserves configured storage across refreshes and invocation paths.
